steps.title: After akh Rhai cast starts
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 2, 8m north-east of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 8m north-west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 8m north-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 8m south-east of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 8m south-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 8m south-west of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 8m south-west of the centre.

steps.title: After akh Rhai resolves
steps.rule: Stand near waymark C, 11m south of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 3m north-east of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 5m east of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Go to 5m west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 3m north-west of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 10m south-west of the centre.

steps.title: After lightsteeped on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: TetherWater).

MainTank.rule: Depends on FreeWaterIndex and TetherWater has MainTank: 3 & no → near C (S 8m); 1 & no → NE 7m; 3 & yes → near A (N 8m).

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FreeWaterIndex).

RegenHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Waters has CasterDps).

ShieldHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Waters has CasterDps).

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: EastWing).

steps.title: After lightsteeped on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: TetherWater).

MainTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Waters).

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FreeWaterIndex).

RegenHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Waters has CasterDps).

ShieldHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Waters has CasterDps).

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: EastWing).

steps.title: After lightsteeped on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: TetherWater).

MainTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Waters).

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FreeWaterIndex).

RegenHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Waters has CasterDps).

ShieldHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Waters has CasterDps).

steps.title: After lightsteeped on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Waters).

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: EastWing).

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on EastWing: false → at 2; true → at 1.

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on EastWing: false → at 2; true → at 1.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Depends on EastWing: false → at 3; true → at 4.

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: EastWing).

CasterDps.rule: Depends on EastWing and Waters has ShieldHealer: false & no → at 3; true & no → at 4; false & yes → at 2.

steps.title: After hallowed Wings resolves
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: SpiritTakerTarget has MainTank).

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: SpiritTakerTarget has OffTank).

steps.title: After hallowed Wings resolves
steps.rule: Stand near waymark A, 6m north of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark C, 6m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: TetherWater has MeleeDpsB).

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: EastWing).

CasterDps.rule: When Waters leaves out H2, stand near waymark C, 6m south of the centre; when Waters includes H2, stand near waymark A, 6m north of the centre.

steps.title: After somber Dance hits you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: SpiritTakerTarget has MainTank).

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: SpiritTakerTarget has OffTank).
